8.6.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.edgeCount¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.edgeCount(layout)¶

Calculate the edge cost of the layout, i.e. the number of (undirected) paths having degree 2 nodes as inner nodes and non-degree 2 nodes as end point nodes. The layout can be either a railyard or an area.

Parameters:layout (IRailyard | IGraph) – The railyard/area we are calculating the edge-cost for.
Return type:int
Returns:The edge cost.
